findings.claim: Engine appearance mirrored through @Published; generated window observes engine and passes appearance to ThemeChoice. No source-proven missing observation link.
ThemeChoice synchronously changes NSApplication.appearance in a view change callback. Setter logic inherited from origin/master. Possible runtime reentrancy site only; no causal evidence.
13 uses LegacyOnChange; 14 uses native onChange. Stable ActionBox refreshes latest action during body, tracks previous value, and owns no lock. No source-proven stale appearance capture.
MacOS Combine model is shared by this branch on 13 and 14, unlike upstream Observation; potentially broader invalidation is not evidence of lost updates or of a 13-only defect.
ui.activate ACK follows action closure, not engine-state application or native redraw. Engine dispatch is asynchronous.

State/reply/session callbacks enqueue main.async. Rust releases state/listener locks before listener calls, and pending lock before session callback. No obvious lock cycle found on this inspected path; absence is not an exhaustive proof.
Display-link invalidation waits for in-flight callback. No source or runtime evidence links that path to this appearance action; lower-priority suspect only if a stack actually reaches it.
